species_partition.eligible_species_source: frozen measured pool after >=40 classifiable-photo gate
species_partition.canonical_order: lexicographically sorted species labels from canonical_colour_pool

outer_schedule.per_fold_operation: within each original outer realization, filter scheduled species into complementary training and held-out sets without replacement or substitution

field.colour_distance: Jensen-Shannon divergence in bits on four-group colour vector
field.consensus: sum subset outer colour numerators divided by sum subset outer opportunities over subset-evaluable outer cells

cross_prediction.per_fold_statistic: symmetric opportunity-weighted Pearson correlation between training-species and held-out-species consensus fields
cross_prediction.joint_cells: cells with finite train and held-out consensus values and positive aggregate opportunity in both
cross_prediction.cell_weight: sqrt(training aggregate opportunity * held-out aggregate opportunity)
cross_prediction.weighted_correlation_formula: weighted covariance divided by square root of weighted train variance times weighted held-out variance
cross_prediction.global_statistic: median of all five fold correlations
cross_prediction.positive_fold_gate: at least four of five observed fold correlations > 0

null.unit: complete four-group colour vector permuted within species with each null assignment reused across all 200 outer realizations
null.global_null_statistic: median of the same five fold correlations for each null index

supported_if_all: at least four of five observed fold correlations > 0
decision.claim_if_supported: common multi-zone flower-colour boundary architecture across species
decision.claim_if_not_supported: no species-disjoint support for common boundary architecture; retain lower-level recurrence and robustness results only
